summary: Tested the owner-only AI Business Manager and the Expenses & profit page end to end on preview, against the backend and the UI. I cleaned up the leftover code in test_iter14_business_manager_finance.py, added tests for priorities, memory dedupe, delete-404 and saved suggestions, plus staff/DB cleanup. All 27 backend tests passed with real LLM, STT and TTS calls. UI flows that passed: nav items, starter question with thinking indicator, streamed reply and auto title; follow-up kept its context; stop showed 'Stopped' and the partial reply was saved on reopen; new chat, reopen, search (Enter) and the no-match empty state; delete with confirm dialog; memory suggestion saved, still shown on reopen, and appears in the memory tab; memory add/edit/delete; priorities (3 cards, approve, checklist, check toggle kept after reload, dismiss, complete, history); read aloud plays and stops; finance TEST_ expense add/delete updates KPIs; demo job costs update job-profit and are left out of KPIs; mobile 390x844 (conversations sheet, composer visible, no overflow); regression pages load. Voice UI: with the fake-device Chromium flags the mic opens data-state=listening and Cancel returns to idle. Real speech was fed by replacing getUserMedia with a stream of /speak TTS audio (ffmpeg/WAV wasn't available). The full loop worked: listening -> transcribing -> a 'You said' bubble with an exact transcript -> spoken reply with £0/demo-excluded figures -> speaking -> Stop speaking returns to idle. The AI did not invent figures: it reported £0 and pointed to the 14 excluded demo records. One data bug: the snapshot counts a demo-tagged customer escalation.

minor.issue: customer_escalations_open counts demo records: tdb.conversations.count_documents({escalated, needs_human}) has no LIVE filter. The only open escalation in the DB is demo:true (6acb25e09a4ed56aa0a25fd6), yet the AI said '1 customer escalation is open' and made 'Resolve the open customer escalation' a HIGH priority. carpet_quotes_awaiting_admin and walkthrough_requests_open have no demo filter either (currently 0 demo, so no effect yet).

Reports 3 'sent' quotes that are not demo-tagged (created 2026-10-11/20, most with lead_id null). They look like leftovers from earlier test iterations, and the AI recommends chasing them as real pipeline. The main agent should check whether they are real or should be demo-tagged/removed.
After stop, the saved partial (961 chars) is slightly longer than what the user saw (924), because the server keeps streaming until it notices the disconnect. Harmless.

issues: Tabs wrap: 'Business memory' drops to a second line outside the grey TabsList pill. Make the list scroll horizontally or set it to h-auto.
The composer placeholder is cut off after two lines ('...or tap the').
Between transcribing and speaking, the voice bar disappears (state idle) while the AI is thinking. A 'thinking' voice state would make hands-free use clearer.
The expense date and the month filter use the browser's native date/month pickers instead of the shadcn calendar.
The Job costs KPI says 'all jobs costed' when there are 0 jobs. It should say 'no jobs'.

The Overview dashboard shows £327 revenue and 6 leads, which include demo records, while the AI Manager and Finance show £0 (demo excluded). The owner may be confused; consider a 'includes demo' label on Overview.
